description: Endless paper-sky aviation arcade game built with React, TypeScript, and Babylon.js.
readme: # AeroFlap > **An endless, illustrated aviation arcade game built for fast, one-more-flight play.** [![CI](https://github.com/vincenzo-afk/AEROFLAP/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/vincenzo-afk/AEROFLAP/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-f24a2e.svg)](LICENSE) [![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-19.2.1-172038.svg)](https://react.dev/) [![Babylon.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Babylon.js-9.22.1-378a62.svg)](https://www.babylonjs.com/) [Repository](https://github.com/vincenzo-afk/AEROFLAP) · [Report a bug](https://github.com/vincenzo-afk/AEROFLAP/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) · [Request a feature](https://github.com/vincenzo-afk/AEROFLAP/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) ## Contents | Section | Description | | --------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | | [About](#about) | Game concept, gameplay, and architecture | | [Tech stack](#tech-stack) | Verified runtime and tooling | | [Getting started](#getting-started) | Local development and production commands | | [Usage](#usage) | Flight controls and demo mode | | [Project structure](#project-structure) | Code ownership and entry points | | [Features and roadmap](#features-and-roadmap) | Implemented capabilities and next scope | | [Testing](#testing) | Validation and continuous integration | | [Deployment](#deployment) | Production build and server instructions | | [Contributing](#contributing) | Contribution workflow | | [Security](#security) | Current security posture | | [License](#license) | License terms | | [Acknowledgments](#acknowledgments) | Project credits | --- ## About AeroFlap is a browser-based endless flying game. The player guides a vermilion paper aircraft through a continuously generated sequence of green sky gates. Each cleared gate raises the score, while terrain, ceiling, and gate collisions end the current run. The interface keeps the best score in browser storage and offers an immediate restart flow. The visual system, **Sunlit Paper Skies**, combines a tactile sky illustration with an aviation-logbook interface. React provides the application shell and accessible HUD, while Babylon.js owns the render loop, scene graph, collision checks, physics values, and obstacle lifecycle. | Implemented capability | Detail | | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Multi-input flight control | Click, tap, Space, and Arrow Up trigger the same lift action. | | Endless obstacle stream | Gate spacing, speed, and gap size are managed by the framework-agnostic game world. | | Score persistence | The best score is retained in `localStorage` under `aeroflap-best`. | | Responsive canvas | The orthographic camera recomputes its viewport on browser resize. | | Demo mode | `?demo` activates a deterministic autopilot for visual verification. | | Accessibility-aware UI | The canvas is labelled, keyboard controls are exposed, and status changes use a live overlay. | | Customization Studio | Players can tune pace, gate opening, colors, sound, and background mode with immediate preview. | | Personal media | Signed-in players can persist their own background image or video, aircraft artwork, ambient track, and lift sound. | ```mermaid flowchart LR Browser[Browser] Shell[React GameCanvas shell] Scene[scene.ts] World[GameWorld] Canvas[Babylon.js canvas] HUD[Flight-deck HUD] Storage[(localStorage)] Browser --> Shell Shell --> Scene Shell --> HUD Scene --> World World --> Canvas World --> Storage World -. state events .-> HUD ``` --- ## Tech stack | Area | Technology | Verified version or role | | ---------------------------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | | Application framework | React | `19.2.1` | | Game rendering | Babylon.js Core | `9.22.1` | | API contract | tRPC | `11.x` | | Persistent data | Drizzle ORM with MySQL/TiDB | `0.44.x` | | Build and development server | Vite | `7.1.7` | | Language | TypeScript | `5.6.3` | | Styling | Tailwind CSS with project CSS | Tailwind `4.1.14` | | Icons | Lucide React | `0.453.0` | | Production server | Express | `4.21.2` | | Package manager | pnpm | `10.4.1` via `packageManager` | | Continuous integration | GitHub Actions | Node.js 22, typecheck and production build | The app is a client-rendered web experience. It does not currently include a database, account system, public API, or user-supplied configuration requirement. --- ## Getting started ### Prerequisites Install **Node.js 22** and **pnpm 10.4.1 or later**. The repository includes a `pnpm-lock.yaml`, so use pnpm rather than npm or Yarn to preserve the tested dependency graph. #
